name: NavigationMenu
description: A site header navigation with a pill or underline indicator that glides under the hovered item and a shared dropdown panel that springs open, slides between triggers and cross-fades its sub-links and feature card.
a11yNotes: Uses the WAI-ARIA disclosure navigation pattern inside <nav aria-label>: items with sub-links are native buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the panel; plain items are links. Left/Right/Home/End move between top-level items, ArrowDown opens a menu and focuses its first link, Up/Down move through panel links, and Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger. The panel closes when focus or a pointer leaves the component. Keyboard Enter/Space toggles the panel even in hover mode. The hover indicator is aria-hidden; reduced motion removes sliding and scaling.

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.type: { label: string; href?: string; links?: { label: string; description?: string; href?: string }[]; feature?: { title: string; description: string; href?: string } }[]
propsApi.description: Top-level items; items with links get a dropdown panel.

propsApi.name: brand
propsApi.description: Brand text on the left; empty string hides it.

propsApi.name: ctaLabel
propsApi.description: Call-to-action label on the right; empty string hides it.

propsApi.name: indicator
propsApi.description: Style of the gliding hover indicator.

propsApi.name: openOn
propsApi.description: Open panels on pointer hover (click also works) or on click only.

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Color of the feature card, CTA and link highlights.

propsApi.name: minHeight
propsApi.description: Minimum height of the root in pixels so the open panel has room; use 0 in a real header.

propsApi.name: ariaLabel
propsApi.description: Accessible label of the nav landmark.

propsApi.name: onNavigate
propsApi.description: Called when any link is activated. Links with href '#' are not followed.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
